title: FREE REQUEST [Recruiting] The Last Concord - A Dark Fantasy RPG (Mappers, Sprite rs, Writers)

posts.author: SinfulPride
posts.body:
I'm excited to announce a new project,
The Last Concord
, and I'm looking for a few passionate collaborators to help bring this dark fantasy world to life in
RPG Maker MZ
.
About the Game
​
Title:
The Last Concord
Genre:
Dark Fantasy, Isekai, Story-Rich RPG
Engine:
RPG Maker MZ
Synopsis: Long ago, the deities of the aether and nether created the world and everything in it. Over time, the races of the world began to build countries of their own and lived in relative harmony. One day, one of the gods of the nether, created a massive titan in which to shape the world as he envisioned. The world as they knew it, almost came to an end, but the titan managed to be sealed. 10,000 years have passed, and the seal is slowly coming undone, select few even know of the titan, and history has all but forgotten it. Cut to current time, and our main character Zane has been summoned to this world accidentally. It will be, eventually, up to him to help save the world.
Project Status
​
The project is currently in the early stages of development. The core story arcs, world lore, characters, races, and unique gameplay systems have been extensively planned out. We have:
A detailed world with 7 continents and dozens of unique nations.
A rich pantheon of deities and a defined magic system.
A fully realized main cast and a deep roster of potential party members.
A robust power-scaling and progression system.
Functioning prototypes for the core, unique gameplay mechanics (Conclave of Souls, Stress Gauge, etc.)
Now, we need to bring the world to life visually.
My Role(s)/Position(s): I'll be writing the story, programming/coding everything, making the scenes/formulas, things of that nature.
Who We're Looking For
​
I am primarily looking for artists, but I am very open to collaborative writing as well.
1. Mapper (Lead Role):
Responsibilities:
Designing and creating the game's maps, from grand throne rooms and bustling cities to dark forests and ancient ruins.
Looking for someone who:
Has a strong sense of atmosphere and environmental storytelling.
2. Sprite Artist (Character/Monster):
Responsibilities:
Creating custom sprites for the main characters (Zane, Kaelen, Elara, etc.) to make them stand out from default assets. Potentially creating custom sprites for key monsters or bosses down the line.
Looking for someone who:
Can create expressive character sprites that match the established character designs and personalities.
3. Writer / Story Contributor:
Responsibilities:
Assisting with writing dialogue, creating side quests, developing character arcs for the large cast, and fleshing out lore for the various nations and factions.
Looking for someone who:
Enjoys dark fantasy themes, political intrigue, and character-driven storytelling. If you love world-building, this is a great opportunity to contribute.
How to Apply
​
If you are interested in joining
The Last Concord
, please send me a private message here on the forums. Tell me a little bit about yourself, which role you're interested in.
This is a passion project, and the goal is to create a memorable, story-rich experience. I am excited to find like-minded people to collaborate with.
Thank you for your time and consideration!

posts.author: Anthony Xue
posts.body:
Canned_Dinosaur said:
Do you have any games released?
Click to expand...
Honestly, this is probably the most important question in the thread. Your list of "7 continents and dozens of unique nations" with "bustling cities", for instance, amounts to 1,000+ maps for those cities alone, even with conservative estimates (three dozen nations, each with three cities, each with 10 maps - really busy cities with multiple districts, sewers, numerous shops could easily have 100 maps). And this doesn't even count the caverns, castles, mountains, forests etc., which will probably add another thousand maps. Assuming that each of those has about 50 events, another very conservative estimate, we will have... well...
Dreaming up such lands is
so much fun
. Implementing them is
so much work
. Telling from experience (2 nations, 6 cities, 60 dungeons, three years, half of which basically full-time).
Maybe we shouldn't care if we get paid, and you seem to have considerable financial backing (I assume the "1500+ per month" means USD, which over the course of three years would be somewhere in the area of 60,000 USD). However, you would certainly want any collaborators to stay with you for the entire project to make sure that maps, sprites, conversations etc. are created in an overall matching style. This means we will have to bring a certain degree of passion ourselves, but that would require some trust in your ability to bring such a mammoth project to its completion. So... any track record?
Oh, by the way, as a potential writer (see
here
) I also have to say it's hard to get passionate about your background plot. On the surface, it seems like an amalgamation of overused clichés. Since you say it has been "extensively thought out" (why exactly are you looking for another writer then?), please tell me that there are multiple layers of complexity beneath.
Call me skeptical, but unless proven otherwise, I'd say this game has the well-known look of an overly ambitious passion project ready to crash at the cliffs of reality. I don't mean to ridicule it, I know how passion feels. Just make sure you have an idea of what you're getting yourself into, and what you are asking others to participate in.

posts.author: fallenlorelei
posts.body:
Hey friend, sorry you're getting dunked on here. You have an interesting game idea and people who are interested in it will reach out! The people who aren't interested will say as much here, with the addendum, "I'm just trying to help". There are always recruitment posts from newbies trying to make epic games, and there are always people coming out of the woodwork to tell them it's not going to work, and even if they're right, people will reach out to join because they're
excited
and they
want to
and I love that, and it annoys me when people try to take that away before it could even start.
Even if it doesn't get finished, that's some art being pushed into the world, and we could use some more of that!
As for releasing the game commercially, that's something you and your team can figure out together, if its profit sharing or something else. Good luck!!
I'm excited to see what you guys come up with!

posts.author: PrinceFishy

I can see that this was several months ago, but some of the details have caught my attention. I've been a writer by hobby since I was 12 (currently 32) and am interested in writing some stuff for games. Unfortunately, I do not currently have any examples of what I have to offer to your project. Keep in mind, though, that I would rather discuss in detail what writing has taken place within the project, see examples, and (after seeing examples of what has occurred during this project) do some test runs for you in order to get the correct idea of what you're looking for. I cannot stress the importance of the
test work
phase of me being involved. For example, I will provide 1-3 examples of lore for a nation at a time, take your criticism and suggestions as feedback until I get a clear idea of what you're looking for. If you're still recruiting and am interested, please contact me on Discord at PrinceFishy.
